text:
The schedule I gave earlier satisfies all 17 constraints when I re-check it, so I'm keeping it. The team note doesn't hold up.

The note says Cara must be in slot 4, with Ann in slot 6. I tested that case:
- Hana is in slot 5 and Ann is in slot 6.
- Ben must be at least 3 slots from Cara, so Ben is in slot 7 or later.
- Elif must be after Ann, so Elif is in slot 7 or later.
- Ivo must come after Cara and can't be in 5 or 6, so Ivo is in slot 7 or later. Ivo, Finn and Gus then take slots 7, 8 and 9.
- That leaves no room for Ben and Elif, so the case fails.

The note's reasoning that Dev's distance from Ivo pushes Cara to slot 4 is also wrong, because Dev can sit in slot 1 with Cara in slot 2.

I only worked through the case with Cara in slot 2, so I haven't shown this is the only valid schedule.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Dev","2":"Cara","3":"Hana","4":"Ann","5":"Ben","6":"Ivo","7":"Finn","8":"Gus","9":"Elif"}
CONFIDENCE: 98
